headline.text: L3 ML4 sweco clogged with caramel contamination, *45 minutes down* for emergency wash at 03:28

per_plant_summary.L1: S4 ran twist-wrapped caramel with repeated equipment damage from oversized pieces. Theegarten knife set damaged again at 07:01 — bent fingers and fold plate from caramels running too long and high. S3 ran after maintenance secured loose scraper guard hardware found at 06:46. S2 held for jars until first delivery arrived at 10:30.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 depositor struggled with clogged filter through third shift — still troubleshooting heat-up at end of window. FFS paused briefly at shift change when lot code wasn't updated, creating 4 pallets of potential rework. ML2 depositor dripped on molds at 02:32 after operator training error left branch pump off.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 sweco overflow at 02:43 due to caramel contamination required emergency wash and restart. Line ran with 200+ damaged molds in system as of 06:32. ML1 Cavanna printer alarmed after ink cartridge change at 07:11, maintenance still working. Truffle line unable to load work order labels into system at 04:33, IT issue escalated.

resolved.title: S4 damaged gasket on sucrotherm valve
resolved.summary: Gasket on valve from reserve to sucrotherm damaged, caramel passing through even when closed; risk of foreign material in product
resolved.resolution: Gasket replaced at 15:16, reserve drained and flushed; missing piece not found in candy or water, MD test negative (Conner Boyd, Angelica Perez)

resolved.title: ML3 spatula broken in batch during mixing
resolved.summary: Blade hit spatula left in bowl during active mixing, breaking it inside the batch; safety risk of hands in equipment while running
resolved.resolution: Batch and spatula scrapped; safety discussion with team at 09:57 (Alex Mendoza)

resolved.title: FFS metal detector machine fault
resolved.summary: Line down at 08:14 for maintenance to fix metal detector machine

resolved.title: ML3 first speed belt out of position
resolved.summary: First speed-up belt kept stopping, maintenance performed hard reset
resolved.resolution: Back up at 11:11 — "Line is back up. First speed belt was out of position" (Alex Mendoza)

resolved.title: ML3 PG-11 flow wrapper sensor failure
resolved.summary: Line down for maintenance to replace PG-11 FW sensor
resolved.resolution: Running at 13:04 — "The line is running" (Molding Line 3 Pack)

resolved.title: ML3 cooler fault causing line stop
resolved.summary: Line down at 19:32 due to cooler issues
resolved.resolution: Running again at 19:42 — "Line running again" (Molding Line 3 Pack)

resolved.title: ML3 mold jam in cooler from bent transition guides
resolved.summary: Mold stuck in cooler; black transition guides were bent causing jam
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 21:46 — guides bent back out by maintenance, no bent rails observed (Brandon Lance)

resolved.title: ML3 water flow issue to filling tempering device
resolved.summary: No water flow to filling tempering device at start of first shift, maintenance troubleshooting
resolved.resolution: Restored at 06:36 — "We have water flow to the filling tempering device now. We will begin to mix" (Alex Mendoza)

resolved.title: ML4 sweco overflow and caramel contamination
resolved.summary: North side sweco clogged with material that tasted like caramel, causing overflow and spill; line down for emergency wash and cleaning
resolved.resolution: Sweco cleaned and reinstalled by 04:21 — "North side Sweco was cleanes and reinstalled, currently waiting for temper to start the line" (Frederick Peairs)

resolved.title: ML4 separator sending everything to discharge
resolved.summary: Separator malfunction routing all product to discharge instead of sorting; paused for cleaning and capture test
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 08:23 after cleaning back-off plow, scrapers, and capture test; depositing on depositor 1 (Itzel Chavez)

resolved.title: ML4 cream filling depositing off-center
resolved.summary: Cream filling depositing outside the mold center; green side rail loose causing molds to uncenter
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 09:30 — "The green side rail needed to be adjusted it was loose...It's depositing good now" (Itzel Chavez)

resolved.title: ML4 mold jams from broken licking roller 2
resolved.summary: Over 25 jams in cooling cabinet 1; licking roller 2 broken since snack size run, sits too low and causes mold jams when activated
resolved.resolution: Workaround at 09:25 — deactivated 2nd licking roller, no more jams after 10 minutes of running (Itzel Chavez)

resolved.title: ML4 aligner not separating or rejecting properly
resolved.summary: Stefan worked through morning making programming adjustments to aligner rejection system with multiple start/stops and damaged product reaching gondola
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 13:52 — "All 3 TG's have been running fine with no issues after Stefan fixed his programming on the aligner and we have been running without pauses so far" (Itzel Chavez)

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt moved south side
resolved.summary: C6 belt drifted to south side, maintenance notified at 20:45
resolved.resolution: Running correctly by 22:23 — "Belts running correctly" (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap)

resolved.title: ML4 conveyor belt broken between sticker machine and coder
resolved.summary: Belt broke when end was hitting coder aligner; operators passing boxes manually while locating spare
resolved.resolution: Repaired at 01:51 — "All broken conveyor links were replaced and is already running" (Jose Vasquez)

needs_attention.title: S4 Theegarten knife set damaged from oversized caramels
needs_attention.summary: Knife set damaged again at 07:01 — all inner and outer fold fingers bent, film fold plate knocked out; root cause is caramels running too long and high
needs_attention.status: In repair as of 07:01; Chris Jeffs states "We need to align on a standard and stick to it before the machine is non repairable and our product is compromised"

needs_attention.title: S3 loose scraper guard hardware found
needs_attention.summary: Nut found in metal detector bin from scraper guard; maintenance found several bolts and nuts not properly installed or secured
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on correcting and securing as of 06:46; no confirmation all hardware properly installed

needs_attention.title: ML3 depositor not heating, clogged filter
needs_attention.summary: Depositor heating poorly with accumulated chocolate in hopper; filter clogged at 04:02, cleaned and reinstalled but still struggling to heat up
needs_attention.status: Filter cleaned and installed by 04:37 but still having trouble heating at 04:44; maintenance investigating

needs_attention.title: ML2 mold washer doors issue, operators hand-cleaning molds
needs_attention.summary: Depositor dripped on majority of molds after operator error (branch pump left off); clean molds loaded, operators hand-cleaning while maintenance works on mold washer doors
needs_attention.status: Maintenance continues to work on mold washer doors as of 02:32; operators hand-cleaning molds in interim

needs_attention.title: ML3 thin chocolate layer on top of York pieces
needs_attention.summary: Thinner layer of chocolate on top observed; Brandon adjusted depositing start delay from 368 to 370 ms, then to 372 ms, monitoring every 30 minutes
needs_attention.status: Second adjustment made to 372 ms at 17:09, monitoring continuing; not confirmed as fully resolved

needs_attention.title: FFS lot code error creates 4 pallets potential rework
needs_attention.summary: Lot number not changed at shift change, creating 4 pallets; Gustavo questions whether rework needed since only shift number changes, not lot
needs_attention.status: Line restarted, lot verified, but 4 pallets flagged; Gustavo at 06:52 asks if pallets really need rework — decision pending

needs_attention.title: ML4 good product being rejected on discharge belt
needs_attention.summary: Good product pushed off discharge long belt as though bad; line stopped to reset belts
needs_attention.status: Stopped and reset belts at 02:00 to see if it helps; no follow-up on whether reset worked

needs_attention.title: ML4 excess chocolate in mold return causing molds to hit bolts
needs_attention.summary: Excess chocolate in mold return area pushing molds up and causing them to hit bolts
needs_attention.status: Issue reported at 02:08 with photo; no resolution or follow-up action posted

needs_attention.title: ML4 temper unit 2 user account locked
needs_attention.summary: Cannot enter recipe to start tempering on unit 2 due to locked user account; asked if different account available
needs_attention.status: Asked at 04:08 if different account can be accessed; no resolution or workaround posted

needs_attention.title: Truffle line unable to load work order labels into system
needs_attention.summary: Work order will not load labels into system even after creating new label; system shows ingredients consumed but they're still staged on line
needs_attention.status: Escalated to IT at 06:41 by Fredy — jobs in release mode, will check if resolved or create new job

needs_attention.title: ML4 over 200 damaged molds in system
needs_attention.summary: 200+ molds damaged in system as of 06:32; operators swapping 20 at a time during production, some due to no communication when depositor 4 was down
needs_attention.status: Frederick asked at 04:42 about marking for removal and swapping with clean molds 20 at a time; still in system as of end of window

needs_attention.title: ML1 Cavanna printer alarm after ink cartridge change
needs_attention.summary: Printer received with 0% ink at 07:00; when new cartridge installed, printer triggered alarm and stopped printing
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on it as of 07:11; no resolution posted

needs_attention.title: Truffle line pre-piece breaking due to soft appearance
needs_attention.summary: Pre-piece has not very solid appearance causing it to break; operator making adjustments
needs_attention.status: Operator making adjustments as of 06:19; no confirmation of fix
